mechanics_text: Serves as primary starship of Terran fleet.
Can take massive amounts of damage even from M6 A4 Raccoon beams and multiple nukes.
Pre-1.0.5 update: formidable but defenseless alone.
Post-1.0.5 update: gained turrets for active defense.
version_notes: NPC capital ship. Infobox shows variable stats (armor 7000-7700 range). 7 D2A2 turrets. Not player-purchasable.
